decisions.decision: narrative-viewer.mjs was built as a new local review tool (matching photo-viewer.mjs/blog-viewer.mjs pattern) superseding 06-CONTEXT.md's D-09 ('direct MDX editing, no new review UI')
decisions.rationale: Direct MDX editing didn't provide any way to supply real names for generically-described people or per-day memories the AI can't infer from photos/GPS, or a fast keep/discard action. D-09 was explicitly marked superseded in 06-CONTEXT.md (commit a821f7c), not silently overridden.

decisions.decision: Family notes (site-wide) and per-day memory notes live in .planning/data/narrative-notes.json and are consumed automatically by scripts/11-draft-narratives.mjs's --generate mode - not just from the viewer tool
decisions.rationale: So bulk/future regeneration benefits from whatever context has been filled in, not just single-day regenerates triggered from the tool itself.

decisions.decision: Discarding a day (keep:false) deletes its post file from the site entirely (not just strips the gallery/narrative to a stub)
decisions.rationale: Explicit user choice via AskUserQuestion, overriding my own recommendation (which was to strip-to-stub, matching the land-trip precedent from plan 06-05). scripts/verify-phase6.mjs was updated to fold keep:false dates into KNOWN_GAP_DATES automatically so the '100 in-scope posts' gate doesn't break.

decisions.decision: Photo rotate re-uploads to the SAME R2 key/URL rather than creating a new one
decisions.rationale: So no MDX file ever needs editing when a photo is rotated - every existing reference to that URL automatically shows the corrected orientation.
